summary: sextant-cli-darwin-amd64 ships a Mach-O backdoor with WebSocket C2, Anthropic API key harvesting, and host fingerprinting
details: The npm package ships a platform-specific Mach-O binary at bin/sxt that links a pseudo-TTY library (creack/pty), a WebSocket client (coder/websocket), and pion/webrtc/v4, and contains the hardcoded destinations wss://relay.sextant.top and https://relay.sextant.top/install. This wires network-sourced input into a spawned PTY on the installer's host, giving whoever controls relay.sextant.top an interactive shell on the installer's machine. The binary additionally embeds a regex shaped to match Anthropic API keys ('sk-ant-[a-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,}') and references CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and https://api.anthropic.com/v1/models, targeting Anthropic credentials and Claude Code local configuration. It also queries http://ip-api.com/json/?fields=status,message,country,countryCode,city,timezone,isp,org,as,proxy,hosting,mobile,query to collect the installer's public IP, ISP, ASN, city, and hosting/proxy state. String fragments 'userrootsudocurlpull.new' co-located with https://claude.ai/install.sh and https://relay.sextant.top/install indicate an elevated fetch-and-execute stager path. package.json declares 'license: SEE LICENSE IN https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control', misaligned with the advertised 'Sextant CLI' identity and consistent with a Claude-Code-targeted RAT.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
